verdicts.reason: The two candidates look the same. In both, the long four-line headline is crammed into a tiny banner where it can barely be read. The SOLSTICE logo and the product can are missing or shrunk to a speck, so the brand doesn't survive. The LIMITED EDITION badge is jammed under the headline, the CTA button and the AWARD WINNING tag are crowded into the right corner, and the body copy has shrunk to faint, unreadable lines.
